description: Implementation of the FramebufferVk class for Vulkan rendering in ANGLE, including methods for managing framebuffers, clearing, blitting, and reading pixels.

classes.name: FramebufferVk
classes.description: Vulkan framebuffer implementation for ANGLE, managing framebuffer creation, clearing, blitting, reading pixels, and render pass management.

methods.name: CreateUserFBO
methods.description: Creates a user-defined framebuffer object.

methods.name: CreateDefaultFBO
methods.description: Creates a default framebuffer object associated with a window surface.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the framebuffer.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards specified attachments.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates specified attachments.

methods.name: invalidateSub
methods.description: Invalidates a sub-region of attachments.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears framebuffer attachments based on mask.

methods.name: clearImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual clear operation with specified parameters.

methods.name: clearBufferfv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with float values.

methods.name: clearBufferuiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with unsigned int values.

methods.name: clearBufferiv
methods.description: Clears a buffer with int values.

methods.name: clearBufferfi
methods.description: Clears depth and stencil buffers with specified values.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the format for reading pixels.

methods.name: getImplementationColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the data type for reading pixels.

methods.name: readPixels
methods.description: Reads pixels from the framebuffer.

methods.name: getDepthStencilRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the depth-stencil render target.

methods.name: getColorDrawRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the color draw render target for a given index.

methods.name: getColorReadRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the color read render target.

methods.name: blit
methods.description: Performs a blit operation between framebuffers.

methods.name: resolveColorWithCommand
methods.description: Resolves multisampled color buffers using a command.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer is complete and valid.

methods.name: updateColorAttachment
methods.description: Updates the color attachment at a given index.

methods.name: invalidateImpl
methods.description: Implementation of attachment invalidation.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes framebuffer state with the GL state.

methods.name: updateRenderPassDesc
methods.description: Updates the render pass description based on current attachments.

methods.name: getFramebuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the Vulkan framebuffer object.

methods.name: clearWithRenderPassOp
methods.description: Clears attachments using a render pass load operation.

methods.name: clearWithDraw
methods.description: Performs a clear operation using draw calls.

methods.name: getSamplePosition
methods.description: Returns the sample position for multisampling.

methods.name: startNewRenderPass
methods.description: Begins a new Vulkan render pass for clearing or drawing.

methods.name: updateActiveColorMasks
methods.description: Updates masks for active color components for clearing.

methods.name: getEmulatedAlphaAttachmentMask
methods.description: Returns mask indicating which attachments have emulated alpha.

methods.name: readPixelsImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for reading pixels from a render target.

methods.name: getReadImageExtents
methods.description: Returns the extents of the image used for reading pixels.

methods.name: getCompleteRenderArea
methods.description: Returns the full render area of the framebuffer.

methods.name: getScissoredRenderArea
methods.description: Returns the current scissored render area.

methods.name: onScissorChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the scissor rectangle, possibly restarting render pass.

methods.name: getFirstRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the first available render target.

methods.name: getSamples
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for multisampling.
